SEUS_POSTS.TITLE: Your posts
SEUS_POSTS.SUBTITLE: See how your posts are doing.
SEUS_POSTS.RANGE: Last {days} days · Meta numbers can take up to 2 days

HEADLINE.instagram: Your Instagram was seen {count} times without ads.
HEADLINE.facebook: Your Page was seen {count} times without ads.
HEADLINE.ZERO: Your posts were not seen in the last {days} days.

ACCOUNT_NOTE.instagram: Also counts stories and older posts seen in the period.
ACCOUNT_NOTE.facebook: Also counts videos and older posts seen in the period.

HEADLINE.NO_NUMBER: Meta has not sent the views for the last {days} days yet.

CHANGE.FIRST_PERIOD: First period with numbers: nothing to compare yet.

VIEWS.LABEL: Times seen
VIEWS.HELP: the same person can see it more than once.

PEOPLE.LABEL: People who saw
PEOPLE.HELP_instagram: at most this number. Someone who saw a post and a story can count twice.
PEOPLE.HELP_facebook: each person counts once, even after seeing several posts.

INTERACTIONS.LABEL: Interactions
INTERACTIONS.HELP_instagram: likes, comments, saves and shares, across all posts and stories.

FOLLOWERS.LABEL: Followers
FOLLOWERS.FEW: At {min} followers I show who started following

MESSAGES.LABEL: Messages
MESSAGES.HELP: conversations started in this profile's inbox in the period.

TILES.TITLE: Compared with the previous {days} days
TILES.LEGEND: May include ads: {names}. The rest is without ads.

POSTS.TITLE: Posts from the last {days} days
POSTS.EMPTY_PERIOD: You did not post in the last {days} days.
POSTS.EMPTY_PERIOD_TEXT: Pick a longer period to find your posts.

EMPTY_POST.instagram: Post on Instagram and come back to see how it went.
EMPTY_POST.facebook: Post on your Page and come back to see how it went.

POSTS.TRUNCATED: You posted a lot in this period: showing the 300 most recent posts.

UNAVAILABLE.TITLE: Meta did not send your posts right now.
UNAVAILABLE.TEXT: The numbers above still hold. Try again in a moment.

POSTS.STALE: Meta did not send the posts right now: these are from the last reading.
POSTS.TITLE_WAITING: Posts with comments waiting for you in the last {days} days

CARD.PUBLISHED_NO_INSIGHTS: Posted on {date} · likes and comments only
CARD.WAITING: {count} comment waiting for you | {count} comments waiting for you

NUMBERS.TITLE: Post numbers
NUMBERS.CLICKED: {count} click on the post | {count} clicks on the post

NO_ACCESS.TITLE: You can’t see this post.
NO_ACCESS.TEXT: Ask your account admin to add you to this profile’s inbox.

GONE.TITLE: I couldn’t find this post.
GONE.TEXT: It may have been deleted or belong to another profile. Go back to Your posts.

SUMMARY.ABOVE: This post showed up more than your posts usually do.
SUMMARY.BELOW: This post showed up less than your posts usually do.
SUMMARY.NEW: This post is new: Meta’s numbers arrive within 2 days.
SUMMARY.BOOSTED: This post had an ad. Times shown counts only what was not from the ad; the other numbers include the ad.
SUMMARY.TIMES: This post did well: it showed up {times} times more than your posts usually do.
SUMMARY.DOUBLE: This post did well: it showed up twice as much as your posts usually do.
SUMMARY.WELL_ABOVE: This post did well: it showed up much more than your posts usually do.
SUMMARY.SAME: This post showed up as much as your posts usually do.
SUMMARY.NO_INSIGHTS: The Page doesn’t have 100 likes yet, so Meta only shows the likes and comments of this post.
SUMMARY.NO_NORMAL: Nothing to compare yet: your other posts in this period have no numbers.

SIDE.BOOSTED: Had an ad: only “{name}” is without the ad.
SIDE.INSTAGRAM: Times shown, likes and comments are without ads. People who saw it, saves and shares may include ads.

COMMENTS.TITLE: Comments
COMMENTS.UNAVAILABLE: Meta didn’t send the comments right now.

WHY.escondido: Only you see this comment. Tap Show again to bring it back.
WHY.velho: More than 7 days old: a private message is no longer possible. Reply in the comment.

COMMENTS.PRIVATE_NOTE: The message goes to the Instagram inbox. You can send one per comment, up to 7 days after it.
COMMENTS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the comment from {name}? It disappears from the post for everyone and can’t be undone.
COMMENTS.SENT_UNCONFIRMED: Sent privately. Meta hasn’t confirmed it yet.

DONE.release: Done: you can send a private message again.

COMMENTS.ERROR: I couldn’t do that right now. Try again.

ERRORS.comment_not_found: This comment is no longer on the post.
ERRORS.meta_unavailable: Meta didn’t respond right now. Try again in a moment.
ERRORS.meta_refused: Meta didn’t allow this on this comment.
ERRORS.private_reply_not_pending: This private message was already handled.
ERRORS.not_inbox_member: You are not in this profile’s inbox.

CARE_OFFER.TITLE: What's in the comments
CARE_OFFER.QUESTIONS: {count} question: I can answer privately | {count} questions: I can answer privately
CARE_OFFER.QUESTIONS_OLD: {count} question older than 7 days: yours to answer | {count} questions older than 7 days: yours to answer
CARE_OFFER.QUESTIONS_YOU: {count} question: left for you | {count} questions: left for you
CARE_OFFER.COMPLAINTS: {count} complaint: left for you | {count} complaints: left for you
CARE_OFFER.TEXT: If you turn it on, I answer questions privately and say so on the comment. You choose whether I answer the ones already here.
CARE_OFFER.TEXT_MIXED: If you turn it on, I answer new questions privately. Of the ones already here, I can answer the most recent one, if you want. | If you turn it on, I answer new questions privately. Of the ones already here, I can answer the {count} most recent ones, if you want.
CARE_OFFER.TEXT_ONLY_NEW: If you turn it on, I answer new questions privately. The ones already here are older than 7 days: answer them on the comment.
CARE_OFFER.TEXT_FUTURE: If you turn it on, I answer new questions privately.
CARE_OFFER.TEXT_SOON: Sending it privately on Messenger isn't available yet. As soon as Meta allows it, you turn it on here.
CARE_OFFER.NEEDS_PERMISSION: To tell you what's in the comments, I need access to them.
CARE_OFFER.UNAVAILABLE: I couldn't read the comments right now.
CARE_OFFER.MORE: I read the {count} most recent ones without a reply.

CARE_ON.ERROR: I couldn't change it right now. Try again.

CARE_HERO.paused: Paused: you answer the new ones

POST.CARE_ERROR: I couldn't check right now whether I'm taking care of this post's comments.

NO_INBOX.TITLE: Connect your Instagram to see how your posts are doing.
NO_INBOX.TEXT: Once connected, I show here how each post went.
NO_INBOX.ASK_ADMIN: Ask the account administrator to connect Instagram or the Facebook Page.
NO_INBOX.PAGE: Using a Facebook Page? Connect the Page

NO_PERMISSION.TEXT_instagram: Instagram asks for your permission once. Then you come back to this page.
NO_PERMISSION.TEXT_facebook: Facebook asks for your permission once. Then you come back to this page.
NO_PERMISSION.ASK_ADMIN: Ask the account administrator to allow this profile's numbers.
NO_PERMISSION.ERROR: Could not open the authorization. Try again.

NO_ACCESS.TITLE: Your role does not open Your posts.
NO_ACCESS.TEXT: Ask the account administrator to add Your posts to your role.

ERROR.TITLE: Could not load your posts.
ERROR.TEXT: Check your connection and try again.

UNAVAILABLE.TITLE: Meta did not answer right now.
UNAVAILABLE.TEXT: This profile's numbers come back as soon as Meta answers.

SEUS_POSTS.STALE: Meta did not answer right now: these are the numbers from the last reading.

ATTENTION.TEXT: {count} comment waiting for you on {posts} | {count} comments waiting for you on {posts}
ATTENTION.TEXT_OR_MORE: {count} or more comments waiting for you on {posts}

COMMENTS_ACCESS.TITLE: Allow the comments of this profile
COMMENTS_ACCESS.TEXT: To see who is waiting for you in the comments, Meta asks for your authorization once.
COMMENTS_ACCESS.ASK_ADMIN: To see who is waiting for you in the comments, ask your account admin to allow this profile.
